name: filter.withIgnored
title: Field: filter.withIgnored
description: Meaning of the buyer query filter.withIgnored field.
text:
# filter.withIgnored

TL;DR:
- filter.withIgnored controls whether ignored listings may appear in the result set.

What it means:
- True allows listings ignored by the current user to remain visible in results.
- False excludes them.

Agent hint:
- Use this when the workflow explicitly wants to include or exclude already-ignored listings.
